big_case.notes: A single-defendant state attempted-murder prosecution raising a Scott/Evans acquittal-characterization question on an idiosyncratic compulsory-process dismissal. Real liberty stakes for the petitioner (retrial after a ruling labelled an acquittal) but no amici, a waived response, one distribution and a bare denial; negligible reach beyond the parties.
